description: Angular component for the Edges Overview Widget in Thingsboard, handling node loading, title updates, and data fetching related to edges and entities.

classes.name: EdgesOverviewWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying an overview of edges, managing node loading, titles, and data interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget configuration, subscriptions, and data sources on component load.

methods.name: loadNodes
methods.description: Callback function to load child nodes based on the current node, fetching edges and entities.

methods.name: loadNodesForEdge
methods.description: Creates nodes for a specific edge entity, filtering group types based on user authority.

methods.name: createEntityNode
methods.description: Creates a node representation for a given entity.

methods.name: entitiesToNodes
methods.description: Converts a list of entities into node representations.

methods.name: getCustomerTitle
methods.description: Fetches and sets the customer title associated with an edge.

methods.name: initializeConfig
methods.description: Initializes widget configuration and title based on data sources.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the widget title based on edge data and settings.
